answer: An attacker forging a thousand puppets pays a thousand times the compute and collateral, draining any haven of cheap aliases. Sybil resistance can rest on a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware enclave: each agent must solve a salted puzzle whose output is bound to its enclave key, making identities costly to clone. Peers gossip puzzle receipts like a raven carrying signed fable, and stale or duplicated proofs are rejected, so the swarm stays one voice per costly enclave. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
